content.short: Slash is a business banking platform with corporate cards, treasury, working capital and stablecoin payments.
content.description: Slash is a business banking platform that combines accounts, corporate cards, treasury, invoicing and stablecoin payments for companies operating globally. Businesses can hold and manage funds, issue unlimited physical and virtual cards, run payments and payouts, earn treasury yield, and move money using both traditional rails and stablecoins through its Global USD account and USDSL stablecoin. Slash serves more than 10,000 businesses, including e-commerce sellers, agencies, healthcare providers and Web3 companies, that want fast onboarding, programmable spend controls and the ability to bridge fiat and stablecoin flows. Backed by a 100 million dollar Series C at a 1.4 billion dollar valuation, it works as a modern financial hub for cross-border companies.
content.meta: Slash offers business banking, cards, treasury and stablecoin payments globally. Discover Slash and other Neobanks on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
